public_rationale: The announced and reported components approximately reproduce the $718 billion headline sum. They do not prove an exact outstanding contractual balance. Investment announcements also do not establish that every transaction loses money or that those losses make further venture funding indispensable. Reported positive gross margin is material counterevidence to that inference, but it is not matching transaction-level evidence. The unspecified accounting basis also prevents a supported or contradicted money assessment.
limitations: Some announced commitments predate the target period and may have changed or been partly consumed.
The Google amount rests on reporting Reuters could not independently verify.
Aggregate gross margin, net losses, and financing needs measure different things.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Anthropic and OpenAI have promised $718 billion to Microsoft, Google and Amazon and cannot survive without venture capital funding because their underlying businesses lose money on every transaction.

statement.excerpt: These companies have promised $718 billion to Microsoft, Google and Amazon, and cannot survive without venture capital funding, because their underlying businesses lose money on every transaction
statement.document_title: Am I Meant To Be Impressed?

from_speaker: cannot survive without venture capital funding
because their underlying businesses lose money on every transaction
our_interpretation: The commitment figure concerns combined multiyear cloud-compute promises outstanding at publication, not annual spending or recognized debt.
The plain reading of losing money on every transaction is that customer transactions fail to cover the costs of supplying them. Company-wide net losses alone do not establish this.
Survival dependence requires evidence that available cash, operating receipts, and feasible alternative financing cannot sustain the businesses without further venture funding.

Assess commitments as of May 6, 2026 and operating economics over January–March 2026, the latest completed calendar quarter. The combined target interval accommodates the point-in-time commitment claim and the latest-quarter operating claim.
No accounting basis or allocation of training, research, and overhead costs to individual transactions is supplied. The contract therefore records an unknown basis.
criteria.support_condition: A nonduplicated reconciliation establishes approximately $718 billion of relevant promises, transaction-level records establish negative economics throughout both businesses, and cash-flow and financing records establish that those losses cause dependence on further venture funding.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Matching records materially disprove the commitment total, establish profitable transactions under the stated cost definition, or demonstrate sustainable operation without further venture funding.
